message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Java CI

env:
    JDK_CURRENT: 21
    DISTRIBUTION: zulu

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - master
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - master

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
            - name: Set up JDK
              uses: actions/setup-java@d1374f8ac74474200d16ef8ecee22c7ae7a51880 # v6
              with:
                  java-version: ${{ env.JDK_CURRENT }}
                  distribution: ${{ env.DISTRIBUTION }}
            - name: Cache Maven dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
              with:
                  path: ~/.m2/repository
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
                  restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
            - name: Build with Maven
              run: mvn -B clean install

    deploy:
        # releases are published locally with the maven-release-plugin: skip its release commit
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/') && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, '[maven-release-plugin] prepare release')
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        needs: [build]
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
            - name: Set up JDK
              uses: actions/setup-java@d1374f8ac74474200d16ef8ecee22c7ae7a51880 # v6
              with:
                  java-version: ${{ env.JDK_CURRENT }}
                  server-id: central-portal-snapshots
                  server-username-env-var: MAVEN_USERNAME
                  server-password-env-var: MAVEN_PASSWORD
                  distribution: ${{ env.DISTRIBUTION }}
            - name: Cache Maven dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
              with:
                  path: ~/.m2/repository
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
                  restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
            - name: Deploy to Sonatype
              run: mvn -B -DskipTests deploy
              env:
                  MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USER }}
                  MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PWD }}

    doc:
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/')
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        needs: [deploy]
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
            - name: Set up JDK
              uses: actions/setup-java@d1374f8ac74474200d16ef8ecee22c7ae7a51880 # v6
              with:
                  java-version: ${{ env.JDK_CURRENT }}
                  distribution: ${{ env.DISTRIBUTION }}
            - name: Cache Maven dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6
              with:
                  path: ~/.m2/repository
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
                  restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
            - name: Generate and push doc
              run: chmod -R 777 ./ci/*.sh && ./ci/push-doc-to-gh-pages.sh
              env:
                  GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches Maven dependencies in the build job, but the deploy and doc jobs also run Maven commands (deploy and doc generation) without caching, causing repeated dependency downloads. Evidence from experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2 (P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE) shows adding Maven cache to a Java workflow reduced elapsed time by 51%. Additionally, the workflow lacks job timeouts; historical runs take 10-13 minutes, so a 15-minute timeout prevents runaway consumption. Experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) shows adding a custom timeout reduced elapsed time by 27%. This change adds Maven caching to deploy and doc jobs and sets a 15-minute timeout on all three jobs, preserving all build/test coverage and permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2",
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"
  ]
}
